Subject: Quick ask: extra sandbox tokens for overnight soak

Hi Tessa,

We have an overnight soak scheduled for Sat 8/1 starting at 01:00 AM ET to validate our ingestion pipeline with sustained traffic (target ~220 RPS, 8k concurrent short requests). The current trial allotment will run out mid-window according to our estimates.

Can Redwood provision a short, one-time supplemental sandbox fund just for this soak? We only need about 120k more token-equivalents (rough estimate) to finish the 10-hour run.

What we need from your side:
- A one-time top-up to cover the run (start: 01:00 AM ET 8/1, duration ~10h)
- Quick confirmation of any rate limits that might be bumped for the soak (they use 80ms target p95; we'll cap at 250ms).

I attached the soak plan (small) and can share a read-only dashboard if that helps. This is a POC-critical test for our upcoming release; a short approval would really help us avoid pushing the test window.

Thanks,
Jessica
